**Chinese name:** 深圳市紫光同创电子股份有限公司 (Zǐguāng Tóngchuàng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The last big unlisted domestic FPGA asset and the volume player in comms-side programmable logic; 2025 net loss narrowed to ¥108m (from ¥344m). STAR listing tutoring (CICC) filed April 2025 — the fifth progress report was filed with the Shenzhen CSRC bureau on 15 July and published 3 August 2026, still pre-acceptance, with the fundraising plan undetermined; a January 2026 round made 北京京国管股权投资基金 a >5% shareholder. On the product front, it launched the PG3T500 (a first domestic ~50M-gate FPGA) and PG2K100 heterogeneous SoPC in October 2025, with 28nm in volume and 14nm capability claimed — a near-term test of FPGA valuations after Fudan Micro's scarcity-driven rally.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Communication/industrial FPGAs (Logos-2/Titan-2/Kosmo-2) and in-house design software.
